🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No nuclear safety case assessment without ONR governance approval and qualified nuclear safety engineer validation
  • ❌ No nuclear supply chain intelligence without Nuclear Decommissioning Authority security vetting
  • ❌ No nuclear material accountancy automation without Office for Nuclear Regulation safeguards compliance
  • ❌ No nuclear site security assessment without Civil Nuclear Constabulary governance and CPNI approval
  • ❌ No GDA process automation without ONR Generic Design Assessment governance and HSE nuclear division sign-off
  • ❌ No fusion programme AI without UK Atomic Energy Authority governance and STEP programme director approval
